title: Customers with a completed order in both 2024 and 2025
prompt: Which customers placed at least one completed order in 2024 AND at least one completed order in 2025 — i.e., they kept coming back across the year boundary?
population: Completed orders placed in 2024 and completed orders placed in 2025.
transformationPlan: find customers with a completed order in 2024
find customers with a completed order in 2025
referenceSql: SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2025-01-01' INTERSECT SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

commonWrongAnswers.sql: SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
commonWrongAnswers.whyWrong: Returns every customer who ordered at any point across both years, not specifically those with at least one order in EACH year — a customer active only in 2024 would wrongly be included.
